# overctrl

> > A technical blog by Marcos Gonçalves exploring LLM prompt engineering, Clean Architecture, TypeScript best practices, and AI-driven development workflows.

This publication launched in January 2025 and focuses on practical software engineering topics including AI Ops, developer experience optimization, and modern web development with TypeScript and React. The author shares insights on building production-ready systems with clean architecture principles.

## Key Topics

- LLM prompt engineering
- Clean Architecture
- TypeScript
- AI Ops & ML automation
- Developer experience
- Performance optimization
- React & JavaScript
- Tech debt management
- Software architecture patterns
- Production AI systems
- Best practices
- Frontend development
- Anomaly detection
- Career guidance

## About

- [overctrl](https://blog.overctrl.com): Homepage featuring LLM prompt engineering, clean architecture, and AI dev
